title: The Owner edits a flow draft's subject and text before it goes out
description: Drafts a flow cycle writes can be listed, approved and rejected (FW-C-046) but not changed, so the Owner rewrites them by hand outside FlowWeb. Add POST /v1/supervisor/flows/{key}/drafts/{id}/edit with { subject?, body? }, CLI token only. It rewrites the draft file atomically, keeps its status, stamps edited_at, and answers the draft. It answers 400 when neither field is given, a field is not a string, the body is empty, or a field is over 20,000 characters, and 409 with a reason starting handed_off once the draft is in the outbox (the outbox file is never changed). Approving an edited draft hands off the edited text. The CLI gains fw supervisor edit <flow> <id> [--subject <s>] [--body <b> | --body-file <path>] with --json. The list route answers edited_at when set.
acceptance: Editing needs the CLI token (401 without)
An edit changes the subject and body the list shows, keeps the status and stamps edited_at
No fields, an empty body or a non-string field answers 400 and changes nothing
Approving an edited draft hands off the edited body; editing it afterwards answers 409 handed_off and leaves the outbox file as it was
fw supervisor edit <flow> <id> --subject .. --body .. --json edits a draft the same way
